Class ShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.shipBuilding.ShipBoard
Direct Known Subclasses:
SecondShipBoard, TestShipBoard
public abstract class ShipBoard extends Object
Abstract base class representing a player's ship board.

      public abstract Set<Point> getShipArea()
      Gets the valid placement area for components on this ship board. Each ship type defines its own specific valid area for component placement.

      Set of Points representing valid component placement locations

    • removeShipPiece

      public List<Point> removeShipPiece(List<Set<Point>> shipPieces, int pieceIndex)
      Removes sections of the ship while keeping a specified piece. Used during damage resolution when the ship becomes disconnected and a piece must be chosen to keep.

      shipPieces - List of connected component groups
      pieceIndex - Index of the piece to keep
      Returns:
      List of points where components were removed

      public void activateComponent(Point position)
      Activates a component at the specified position. Updates ship statistics based on the activated component's effects. Only applies to components that implement the Activatable interface.
      Parameters:
      position - Location of the component to activate

    • deactivateComponent

      public void deactivateComponent(Point position)
      Deactivates a component at the specified position. Reverts any statistical changes applied when the component was activated.
      Parameters:
      position - Location of the component to deactivate

    • deactivateAll

      public void deactivateAll()
